verdict.rationale: Seeing, attributing, and alerting on observability spend is a fair question for a hosted monitoring vendor like Sentry, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack documents a usage or spend view, per-team or per-service cost attribution, or spike or quota alerts on Sentry's own billing. The 'visualize the spend' claim covers AI-agent (LLM) spend in user applications, not Sentry billing. Pricing tiers and community anecdotes about large bills describe costs, not a capability, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can see what my observability spend is, attribute it to teams or services, and catch usage spikes before the bill
